# Home Cooking FAQ

## Rice
How long should white rice be cooked? White rice should simmer covered for 18 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes off the heat.
Use a ratio of 1 cup of rice to 1.5 cups of water for long-grain rice.

## Eggs
A soft-boiled egg needs 6 minutes in boiling water. A hard-boiled egg needs 10 minutes, followed by an ice bath.

## Food safety
Cooked leftovers should be refrigerated within 2 hours and eaten within 3 days.
Poultry must reach an internal temperature of 74 degrees Celsius.

## Bread
Bread dough should rise in a warm place for about 60 minutes or until doubled in size.
